name: L-Eval
description: L-Eval is a standardized evaluation suite for long context language models, containing 20 sub-tasks with over 2,000 human-labeled query-response pairs across diverse domains and input lengths ranging from 3k to 200k tokens. It also investigates effective evaluation metrics for long context models.
reputation: A well-known benchmark in the long-context LLM evaluation space and frequently cited for assessing long-context understanding.
notes: Includes 20 sub-tasks and 508 long documents; advocates for length-instruction-enhanced evaluation and LLM judges.
